reply:
The largest integer JavaScript can represent exactly is 2^53 - 1 (9007199254740991), which is `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.

2^53 itself is representable as a distinct value, but it's where the loss of precision begins—both 2^53 and 2^53 + 1 map to the same IEEE 754 double-precision float, so you can't reliably distinguish them. That's why MAX_SAFE_INTEGER stops at 2^53 - 1.
